data.name: Rukhan
data.gender_notes: Rukhan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rukhan refers to a state of peaceful calmness and serenity, often achieved through prayer and contemplation. The name Rukhan carries the meaning “Calmness, serenity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rukhan usually hope their child will grow to embody calmness, serenity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Quran describes the state of ruhkhana, where the soul is at peace and tranquil.
data.etymology: Rukhan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Calmness, serenity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rukhan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: ﺮُخًان
in_arabic.meaning: معنى هذا الاسم هو منح سموًا، واسم جميل
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإسم رُخًان في اللغة العربية يأتي من الجذر ر خ ن، ويدل على المكانة العالية، وسمو الشخص، ويوصف به الشخص الذي يمتلك حلمًا كبيرًا، ويدرك قيمة الذات، ويحاول تحسين نفسه دائمًا، ويظهر هذا الإسم في القرآن الكريم في سوره التوبة، آية 128، حيث يُستخدم لوصف سيدنا سليمان، عليه السلام، وأيضاً في حديث صحح من رسول الله، صلى الله عليه وسلم، في صحيح مسلم، حيث يقول: "روحان"، و"روخ" يُستخدم في اللغة العربية للدلالة على السمو، والسموّة، والإرتفاع

in_urdu.name: رخان
in_urdu.meaning: یہ نام ایک بلندو سمجھی گئی حدیث ہے، اور ایک خوبصورت نام ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رخان نام اردو میں لانے والے جذر ر خ ن سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ نام بلندو سمجھی گئی حدیث ہے اور ایک خوبصورت نام ہے۔ یہ نام اس شخص کے لیے ہوتا ہے جو چاہتا ہے کہ اس کی ذات پر اعتبار ہو، اور وہ اس کی صلاحیتوں کا حامل ہو۔ یہ نام سے مراد وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو اپنے آپ کو بہتر بنانا چاہتا ہے، اور سلوک میں اپنے آپ کو بلند مقام پر لانا چاہتا ہے۔ اس نام کا تعلق صدر اسلام کے زمانے سے ہے، جب صحابیوں نے رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے حکم پر یہ نام اپنایا تھا۔

in_hindi.name: रुखान

in_hindi.long_meaning: रुखान नाम हिंदी में लाने वाले जड़ र ख न से मिलकर बना है। यह नाम उच्च और सम्मानित नाम है, और यह एक सुंदर नाम भी है। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए होता है जो अपने आप को बेहतर बनाना चाहता है, और सلوक में अपने आप को उच्च स्थान पर लाना चाहता है। यह नाम का जुड़ाव से समय से है, जब संतों ने रसूल अल्लाह सल्ललाहु अलैहि व सल्लम के आदेश पर यह नाम अपनाया था।

in_english.name: Rukhan
in_english.meaning: This name means someone who is elevated, dignified, and beautiful, and it is a lovely name
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rukhan comes from the Arabic root R-Kh-N, which means to elevate, dignify, and beautify. This name is associated with the concept of someone who strives to elevate themselves, dignify their character, and beautify their soul. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the Prophet Solomon, peace be upon him, who was known for his wisdom, dignity, and beauty. In the Quran, this name is mentioned in Surah Al-Tawbah, verse 128, where it is used to describe the Prophet Solomon. This name has been used in various cultures and languages, including Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, and Turkish, and is considered a beautiful and meaningful name in many Islamic traditions.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic tradition, the name Rukhan suggests a tranquil and composed persona, reminiscent of the peaceful atmosphere during Salah (prayer) and Tasawwuf (Sufi) practices. This name reinforces the value of inner calmness and emotional equilibrium, as reflected in the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) famous Hadith, "The strong is not the one who overpowers others; the strong is the one who controls himself in the presence of anger". The name Rukhan can serve as a reminder for individuals to strive for personal peace and emotional balance, fostering a harmonious environment within their community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Rukhan represents a connection to the Divine, where one feels at peace with themselves and the universe. This tranquility hearkens back to the Hadith in which Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "Allah’s mercy is closer than the protective layer of skin over the tip of your finger." Through regular prayer and contemplation, individuals can seek to align themselves with this Divine presence. In turn, this deep emotional connection nurtures spiritual growth, ultimately allowing individuals to become closer to their true purpose and fulfillment in life.
